data.title: 塑心 · 咖啡馆里的旋律
data.description: 听见街头传来的短促旋律，她拿起笔把它记在纸巾背面，又轻轻敲了两下桌面。
data.camera: 俯角中景，纸笔与咖啡同框
data.promptProse: Seated at a small cafe table by a rain-streaked window, Virtuosa scribbles fleeting musical staves onto a paper napkin using a fine-tipped brass fountain pen. A steaming porcelain cup of espresso on a marble tabletop and blurred cobblestone streets outside complete the quiet afternoon mood.
data.animaCaption: Her pen glides across the paper napkin as she notes down a sudden melody, a contemplative smile gracing her lips beside her warm coffee.
